product.summary: Foundation mobile wallet that can operate as its own self-custody hot wallet and also serves as the companion application for Passport hardware devices.
product.notes: Foundation announced Envoy as a forthcoming Passport companion/mobile wallet in March 2022, and first-party distribution evidence shows Envoy was publicly released during 2022. WLR records year precision only because the reviewed sources do not establish a single defensible initial app-store release day. The later 2023 standalone-hot-wallet expansion is not treated as the initial Envoy launch.

events.title: Foundation Envoy released on mobile platforms
events.description: Foundation released Envoy during 2022 as a mobile Passport companion and Bitcoin software-wallet application for iOS and Android.
events.notes: Year precision only. Foundation stated on 2022-03-10 that Envoy would launch later, while the official Envoy repository published v1.0.7 Android/iOS release artifacts in October 2022 and Foundation subsequently described v1.0.7 as live on mobile platforms.

evidence.title: Passport is now Passport Core
evidence.notes: Primary history source for the 2020 first generation, Founder’s Edition, Batch 2/Core continuity, 2025 rename, Prime, and Envoy product family.

evidence.title: Passport Prime Terms of Use
evidence.notes: Describes Prime as an offline Bitcoin key-management device and Envoy as its companion app, while noting Envoy can hold keys for its own built-in hot wallet.

evidence.title: Introducing Passport Batch 2 & Envoy Mobile App
evidence.notes: First-party pre-launch boundary: Foundation announces Envoy and explicitly says it will launch in app stores later alongside Passport Batch 2. This source is not treated as the release date itself.

evidence.title: Envoy Release 1.0.7
evidence.notes: Official Envoy repository release containing Android App Bundle/APK and iOS IPA artifacts in October 2022. Used with the March pre-launch announcement to establish only that the initial public product launch occurred in 2022.
